content: The function EthIf_SetControllerMode shall forward the call to function <EthDrv>_SetControllerMode of the corresponding Ethernet Con- troller Driver (EthIfPhysControllerIdx) with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE , if mode ETH_MODE_- ACTIVE or ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST has been requested and the corresponding Ethernet Controller Driver (EthIfPhysControllerIdx) has NOT already indicated ETH_MODE_ACTIVE .
